capabilities.title: Durable local conversation and built-in skill registry
capabilities.contract: Each Article has one persisted greeting and a durable local conversation for six built-in Skills. Quick Actions insert a Skill starter and Send remains the sole request trigger. The live Assistant uses a six-step bounded catalog-tool loop with catalog-owned validation, Skill discovery, conversation history, stale-Revision rejection, and one primary generated artifact. It can inspect Article context, Revisions, artifacts, publishing guidance, and Style Corpus state. A separate structured intent check using the configured Text Generation Model accepts explicit exact action requests in the Author's language and fails closed before server validation; orchestrating model tool calls and general Article conversation cannot authorize mutation. Selection-scoped requests remain limited to their selected text and cannot call whole-Article capabilities. Revision-bound requests retain their selected or resolved Skill, completed messages, execution metadata, and review artifacts. Fact Check shows extracted claims as pending or checked, excluding unchanged supported claims. Talking Points prioritizes the active selection, then Author message, then Article. Narrative Draft follows Author direction, develops only the selected source when present, and treats character limits as guidance.
capabilities.persistence: Assistant messages, requests, completed artifacts, and minimal per-capability execution history persist locally. Execution history retains only capability ID, status, request ID, base Revision, and timestamps; Workflow Stage persistence is retired and legacy values remain untouched.

capabilities.title: Streamed responses, progress, cancellation, and error recovery
capabilities.contract: Assistant requests stream typed status, renderer-safe capability activity, and response events. Conversational output reveals completed Markdown blocks without rewriting earlier blocks; review artifacts transition directly from the temporary stream to a short result card with an explicit action to their owning Workspace View, and the current View stays unchanged until the Author follows that action. Streaming follows only when the Author is already near the latest output, while completion brings the outcome control into view unless focus remains in the Assistant. Failed and cancelled requests expose a Retry action that replays only the local persisted input; an unavailable AI connection also offers Application Settings. Incomplete streams do not modify an Article.
capabilities.persistence: Only valid completed request output becomes local message or review-artifact state.

capabilities.title: Thesis-to-narrative composition
capabilities.contract: The server creates a composition Proposal from author-supplied theses; it remains reviewable until acceptance.
capabilities.persistence: Completed proposal artifacts are local and revision-bound.

capabilities.title: Flow revision
capabilities.contract: Flow revision generates a full-text Proposal rather than silently editing the Article.
capabilities.persistence: Completed proposal artifacts are local and revision-bound.

capabilities.title: Fact-check request
capabilities.contract: A fixed server-side fact-check workflow creates advisory findings with per-Fact freshness across Revisions; unchanged Facts and accepted findings remain active.
capabilities.persistence: Findings and citations are stored locally without changing Article text.

capabilities.title: Style review
capabilities.contract: Style review uses only the current compact, explicitly rebuilt profile plus Article-specific manual rules; raw style samples remain local and review findings retain freshness state with the grounded trait or rule that supports each finding.
capabilities.persistence: Raw style corpus and derived review artifacts stay local.

capabilities.title: Translation request
capabilities.contract: Translation requests prepare a translated Article title and linked Article content together; the source Article is never overwritten.
capabilities.persistence: Translation review metadata is local and source linkage remains recoverable.

capabilities.title: Summarized diff review, bulk acceptance or rejection, fallback, and stale protection
capabilities.contract: Authors may review non-authoritative Interface-locale summaries, decide every change locally, apply the accepted subset in one Revision, accept a whole Proposal in one Revision, or dismiss stale and zero-change Proposals without Article changes. Fact corrections preserve blank-line formatting. Summary failure does not block review. Stale and preservation warnings precede labelled change navigation and diff; stale or unreliable Proposals cannot be partially accepted. Whole-Proposal fallback discloses its change count.
capabilities.persistence: Completed Proposal content, summaries with their Interface locale, and the base Revision remain locally recoverable in the Proposal artifact; acceptance creates one immutable Revision and rejection leaves Article history unchanged.

capabilities.title: Explicit request and explicit proposal approval
capabilities.contract: AI operations require an author request; generated text remains separate until explicit author acceptance, with stale-acceptance conflicts handled by the application service.
capabilities.persistence: Only accepted content creates a Revision.

capabilities.title: Named AI connections and environment-variable references
capabilities.contract: Authors configure named AI connections, active selection, testing, and environment-variable names without exposing secret values.
capabilities.persistence: Connection metadata and active selection persist locally; credentials remain environment-provided.
limitations: Connection management and provider breadth remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Refreshed model list and purpose-specific model preferences
capabilities.contract: The default model and built-in-skill overrides determine editorial requests, each with its own reasoning effort. An optional text-generation model handles supporting text such as Proposal summaries, has its own reasoning effort, falls back to the default model, and disables provider-side storage.
capabilities.persistence: Model preferences persist locally; refreshed provider model lists are not persisted.

scenarios.title: Narrative Draft develops Author-controlled material
preconditions: The author explicitly selects Narrative Draft.
scenarios.event: The author requests a narrative from an Article or selection, optionally with a composer message and publishing-profile limit.
expected: Author direction has priority, an active selection replaces whole Article content as the Article source, and the selected character limit is advisory guidance for the resulting complete Article.
The proposal develops supplied ideas simply unless the Author requests otherwise.
forbidden: Inventing unsupported arguments, using unselected Article content, or treating the character hint as an output-token limit.

scenarios.title: Talking Points uses the nearest Author input
preconditions: The author explicitly selects Talking Points.
scenarios.event: The author requests theses with or without a composer message.
expected: An Article selection is the primary thesis source when present and the Author message may guide or explicitly extend it; otherwise a non-empty Author message is used, then Article content.
The default output is 3–5 theses, or focused clarifying questions when direction is ambiguous.
forbidden: Using unselected whole Article content when an Article selection is present.

scenarios.title: Assistant request produces a revision-bound proposal
preconditions: The author has an Article and requests a selected-text improvement.
scenarios.event: The Assistant resolves an eligible skill and completes its request.
expected: The request, messages, and revision-bound Proposal artifact are retained locally.
forbidden: Silent changes to the source Article text.

scenarios.title: Assistant streaming preserves completed blocks and hands off review artifacts
preconditions: An Assistant request is streaming in the Assistant timeline.
scenarios.event: The provider sends partial Markdown text, then stages and completes a conversational or review response.
expected: Incomplete text remains hidden, completed blocks retain their rendered identity, and a review response becomes one result card without its full artifact body.
Streaming does not pull a reader who has scrolled upward; completion exposes its outcome control unless focus is within the Assistant.
forbidden: An empty completion frame or duplicate Proposal content beside its review handoff.

scenarios.title: Failed or cancelled Assistant work remains recoverable
preconditions: An Assistant or editorial stream is in progress.
scenarios.event: The stream fails, is incomplete, or is cancelled.
expected: A stable error can be shown and unfinished output is not persisted as valid work.
forbidden: Modifying the Article with incomplete output.

scenarios.title: Composition and flow revision remain proposals
preconditions: The author explicitly requests an editorial operation.
scenarios.event: The server completes a composition or flow-revision operation.
expected: A reviewable Proposal is produced with the source Article unchanged.
forbidden: Applying generated text without author approval.

scenarios.title: Fact and style review preserve Article text
preconditions: The author explicitly requests a fact or style review.
expected: Revision-tied advisory findings and citations are retained.
forbidden: Review output overwriting Article text or sending raw style corpus text.

scenarios.title: Translation retains source independence
preconditions: The author explicitly requests a translation target language.
scenarios.event: The translation operation completes and the author creates its linked Article.
expected: The linked translation retains source metadata and protected spans.

scenarios.title: Stale proposal remains reviewable but cannot be accepted
preconditions: A Proposal base Revision is no longer current.
expected: The stale warning is shown before review controls, selection actions are disabled, and recovery actions including proposal dismissal remain available.
forbidden: Creating a Revision from a stale Proposal.

scenarios.title: Connection metadata stays distinct from secrets
preconditions: The author configures AI connection metadata.
scenarios.event: The author adds, selects, or removes a connection.
expected: Only environment-variable references and active connection metadata persist.

scenarios.title: Model preferences resolve for new requests
preconditions: A default model, text generation model, or skill-specific override is configured.
scenarios.event: A new editorial request resolves its model.
expected: The applicable editorial override, supporting-text preference, or default model is selected.
forbidden: Treating a refreshed provider list as persisted preference data.
